mentions.name: Music Festival Guest List Manager
mentions.description: A guest list management tool for a music festival, consisting of two front-end apps and a supporting back end: an administrative list management app where names are entered and credentials allocated, and a mobile check-in app for use on the day of the festival. Built with Svelte and FastAPI, it provides improved data entry and lookup UI and widespread, timely synchronization across stakeholders.
mentions.problem: Previous systems ranged from loose sheets of photocopied hand-written notes to poorly-conceived, resource-intensive, and error-prone spreadsheets, and long-time stakeholders were hesitant to give up control in exchange for synchronized data.
mentions.audience: Music festival staff — administrators managing the guest list and check-in personnel using the mobile app on festival day.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a guest list management tool for a music festival.

Nothing technologically ground-breaking: Two front-end apps and the back end to support them.
